scope: Scenario intelligence for Indonesia-linked investments; country scores are scenario assumptions, not observed country risk, official GPR or validated NLP.

methodology.loss_model: exposed asset value multiplied by scenario change in valuation
methodology.quantile: Discrete scenario-weighted 95th percentile (not statistically calibrated market VaR)
methodology.news_type: Source-dated media leads; keyword matching for triage only (not sentiment validation)
excluded: country scores from raw headline counts

drivers.title: Macro — Country and political risk
signals: Regime change, electoral uncertainty, conflict escalation, abrupt tax or currency controls

drivers.title: Meso — Trade and supply chain
signals: Sanctions, logistics chokepoints, tariffs and critical-input disruptions

drivers.title: Micro — Portfolio specific
signals: Revenue concentration, location exposure, vendor substitution and hedging capacity

scenarios.name: Maritime chokepoint disruption
scenarios.pathway: Shipping interruptions → freight costs and delivery delays → imported inputs, inflation and exporter margins.
mitigation: Review route concentration and contractual force majeure
Compare alternate suppliers and delivery lead times
Evaluate, not automatically execute, FX hedging

scenarios.name: Major-power trade restrictions
scenarios.pathway: Tariffs/export controls → suppliers and technology access → relocation feasibility and cost of production.
watch: Technology origin, ownership and contractual restrictions
mitigation: Stress-test alternate export markets and suppliers

scenarios.name: Global energy-price shock
scenarios.pathway: Energy supply shock → fuel, logistics and input costs → Indonesian terms of trade and portfolio margin.
watch: Domestic import bills and fiscal exposures
mitigation: Review supply contracts and inventory resilience
Compare oil importers and energy exporters separately
Assess hedging economics with qualified advisers

scenarios.name: Semiconductor and AI supply disruption
scenarios.pathway: Technology controls → chips / GPU availability → data center capex, equipment lead times and digital investment.
watch: Domestic data-center energy and procurement contracts

scenarios.name: Custom geopolitical event
scenarios.pathway: Define your own transmission chain and scenario assumptions before interpretation.
watch: Set affected countries, sectors and asset exposures
mitigation: Re-run downside sensitivity under multiple assumptions
Escalate material exposures for professional review
